notes: Simplifies Today into a calm daily decision surface with one primary Best move and one primary Apply action.
Native pull-to-refresh remains available and successful loads expose a concise freshness cue while safe existing content is preserved during manual refresh where practical.
Why Now, Evidence, interpretation, assumptions, limitations, expiry and Knowledge Pack metadata move out of the Today surface and remain available through Opportunity Detail.
Later reuses the existing Skip decision semantics; no new Action Decision state or backend change is introduced.
Empty and degraded states become shorter and recovery-oriented without weakening the no-filler recommendation policy.
The implementation remains cross-industry and must not fabricate BI metrics or leak restaurant-specific assumptions into Atlas Core.
Today / History / Goals / Profile persistent navigation remains unchanged.
No API, database, migration, connector, infrastructure, release or production deployment change is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved completing the Today page first, including the proposed concise Best move experience, pull-to-refresh, one- to two-tap actions and restrained semantic card colours.

VS-33 is a bounded mobile presentation/interaction change using existing server states and Action Decision semantics; it introduces no provider, new data collection, retention, external action, authorization, release or production boundary.
Product Owner explicitly approved the written VS-33 design and authorized implementation of the Today page before subsequent suggested intelligence features.
